semanticEnrichment.description: TEXT. FK → plants.SiteKey. Links to parent solar plant.

JSONB column. Stores all IV-curve parameters, inverter & grid metrics, efficiency losses and energy-yield KPIs captured for a single timestamp, so analytics engines can fetch the entire electrical-health view from one JSONB column.
TIMESTAMP. Timestamp when snapshot was taken. Example: 43315.51482.

Represents a time-stamped electrical-performance snapshot for a solar plant, capturing IV-curve parameters, inverter and grid metrics, efficiency losses, and energy-yield KPIs via a single JSONB payload.
